## CONTEXT — Design System (Non-Negotiable Rules)

### Colors — CSS Variables Only
```css
/* Never hardcode colors. Always use these: */
var(--bg-base)        /* near-black background */
var(--bg-surface)     /* slightly lighter surface cards */
var(--text-primary)   /* off-white */
var(--text-muted)     /* dimmed text */
var(--accent)         /* blood red — CTAs, alerts, active states */
var(--border)         /* subtle border color */
```

### Typography
- **Data / addresses / numbers:** `font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace`
- **UI labels / headings:** default body font (Inter, loaded via Google Fonts CDN — already in `layout.tsx`)
- **Never hardcode font sizes below 11px**

### Shared Constants
```typescript
// Import from ConfidenceBadge — don't define locally
import { CONFIDENCE_COLORS } from "@/components/ui/ConfidenceBadge";
// { CONFIRMED: "#22c55e", PROBABLE: "#f59e0b", SUSPECTED: "#b45309", UNKNOWN: "var(--text-muted)" }
```

### Code Patterns (Follow Exactly)
- **Inline styles** throughout — no Tailwind classes in components
- **Skeleton loading** — no spinners
- **`"use client"`** only where hooks/state/events are needed (not on page.tsx if it can stay server)
- **TanStack Query** for all server state: `useQuery`, `useMutation`
- **All API calls** go through `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts` — never fetch inline

## Sprint U1 — Landing Page Hero Wire-up
**Goal:** The landing hero feed shows fake hardcoded transaction data. Wire it to the real `/api/v1/feed/live` endpoint once BUILD creates it.

**Dependency: Requires BUILD Sprint B6 to be complete first.**

### US-U101 — Wire Hero Feed to Real API
> As a visitor to the landing page, I see real on-chain transactions scrolling by.

| | |
|---|---|
| **File** | `apps/web/src/components/landing/LandingHero.tsx` |
| **Current state** | Feed data is hardcoded: fake wallets named "pump.sol", fake amounts |
| **What to change** | Replace hardcoded `FEED_EVENTS` array with `useQuery` calling `GET /api/v1/feed/live` |
| **Polling interval** | Poll every 10 seconds: `refetchInterval: 10_000` |
| **Fallback** | If API returns error or no data, show a skeleton feed (3 placeholder rows) — never show empty |
| **API response shape** | `{ events: [{ tx_signature, from_address, to_address, amount_sol, token_symbol?, from_label?, to_label?, block_time }] }` |
| **Display format** | For each event: `[from_label ?? short_address] → [to_label ?? short_address] · [amount] SOL · [Xs ago]` |
| **Address shortening** | `addr.slice(0,4)}...${addr.slice(-4)` |
| **DONE when** | Hero feed shows real addresses with real timestamps that update every 10s |

## Sprint U2 — Mobile Responsive Layout
**Goal:** The app is desktop-only. This sprint adds responsive breakpoints to the most-used pages.

### useBreakpoint Hook
Create this hook once, reuse everywhere:

```typescript
// apps/web/src/hooks/useBreakpoint.ts
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function useBreakpoint() {
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(
    typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.innerWidth : 1200
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = () => setWidth(window.innerWidth);
    window.addEventListener("resize", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handler);
  }, []);
  return {
    isMobile: width < 768,
    isTablet: width >= 768 && width < 1024,
    isDesktop: width >= 1024,
    width,
  };
}
```

## Sprint U4 — Docs Page Content
**Goal:** `/docs` is a placeholder. Write real content organized into sections.

### US-U401 — Getting Started Guide
> As a new user, I can read how to get started with Bloodhound in under 3 minutes.

| | |
|---|---|
| **File** | `apps/web/src/app/(app)/docs/page.tsx` |
| **Sections to write** | Getting Started, Explorer Guide, Wallet Intelligence Guide, Tracked Wallets Guide, Ask the Hive Guide, Signals Guide |
| **Format** | Static content (no API calls needed). Use a sidebar nav + content area layout. |
| **Sidebar** | Left: section list. Active section highlighted with `var(--accent)`. Content: right 70% |
| **Code blocks** | Style with `background: var(--bg-surface)`, monospace font, subtle border |
| **DONE when** | All 6 sections have ≥ 3 paragraphs of real, accurate content |

**Content outline per section:**

**Getting Started:**
- Sign up with email or social via Clerk
- Run your first wallet search
- Save a wallet to your tracked list
- Set your first alert

**Explorer Guide:**
- How universal search works (wallet / token / tx / program routing)
- What the wallet profile shows (balance, portfolio, activity, classification)
- How to read transaction history (types, directions, filters)

**Wallet Intelligence Guide:**
- What classification labels mean (whale, bot, smart money, insider, KOL)
- How confidence scores work (CONFIRMED vs PROBABLE vs SUSPECTED)
- Side wallet detection — what it is, how the heuristic works
- How to dispute an incorrect label

**Tracked Wallets Guide:**
- Adding wallets with labels
- Creating groups
- Setting alert conditions
- Reading your activity feed

**Ask the Hive Guide:**
- What kinds of questions you can ask
- Example queries (use real addresses)
- How to read evidence responses (tx links, confidence level)
- When to use AI vs. manual exploration

**Signals Guide:**
- What each signal type means (large_transfer, new_wallet_funded, known_wallet_active, etc.)
- How confidence levels are assigned
- How to act on signals
